Dmitri: Quick RFC follow-up 8: we still need a deterministic tie-break when region affinity and cost push different directions.
Maria: Recap: current score = latency_score * w_lat + cost_score * w_cost + region_bonus. region_bonus being binary causes flips.
Aj: Noticed this in canary this morning  a subset moved to cheaper region, 30ms -> 120ms.
Sunita: For latency-sensitive tenants we want bounded degradation first, not cost first. Suggest tier-aware behavior.
Claire: Suggestion: make region_bonus a smooth penalty instead of on/off. e.g.:
```
region_penalty = -alpha * clamp((latency_delta - safe_window) / safe_window, 0, max_scale)
```
so affinity grows as latency delta increases.
Kevin: How do we pick alpha per model/hardware? Need telemetry-derived multipliers.
Dmitri: Start global alpha, then per-model multiplier tuned from 95p regressions weekly.
Aj: Also consider prefix KV cache state  warm caches heavily favor same-region. region_penalty should factor cache_hit_rate.
Sunita: Yes, multiply penalty by (1 - cache_hit_rate) so cold-cache cases bias toward local.
Claire: Draft scoring pseudo: 
```
base = w_lat*norm(latency) + w_cost*norm(cost)
pen = alpha * clamp((latency_delta/safe_window) * (1 - cache_hit), 0, 2)
score = base + pen  # lower is better
```
Kevin: Runtime cost: a few arithmetic ops fine, but ensure cache_hit and latency_delta are O(1) lookups in request context.
Dmitri: Implementation plan: 1) add region_penalty fn in policy-kernel; 2) routing-proxy adds cache_hit, latency_delta in request context; 3) hot flags for alpha/safe_window; 4) canary + A/B.
Aj: We must not push free-tier customers into higher-cost infra by default. Gate strong affinity for tier >= "pro".
Sunita: Default: free stays cost-first unless they opt into affinity in console.
Claire: I'll write the follow-up RFC with concrete equations, telemetry dashboards: 95p/99p latency delta, cost delta, prefix_cache_hit_rate, and A/B metrics.
Kevin: Add automated 95p latency regression alert (>20% change within 24h post-rollout).
Dmitri: Owners: Claire RFC+dashboards, Aj proxy change, Maria policy-kernel API, Kevin alerts. I'll open INF ticket.
InfraBot: JIRA created: INF-4921 "region-penalty-smoothing-and-tiered-affinity" assignee=Dmitri reporter=Claire
Maria: Keep flag default-off so behavior is backward compatible when deployed.
Dmitri: We'll enable canary cohorts after 48h.
Aj: Starting branch for proxy context props.
Sunita: This should reduce the noisy cross-region flips.
Kevin: I'll add a small playbook snippet to infra runbooks after rollout.
Dmitri: Closing thread  Claire will post RFC link in #architecture when ready.
